description: Intent i015 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=helper-param-null-deref) concluded with an evidence-backed negative: no credible cross-function NULL-attribute-dereference variant was found on the assigned priority surface. All 12 triaged helpers that dereference an nlattr* parameter (nla_get_*/nla_data/nla_len/nla_parse_nested*) without their own NULL check were traced to their callers, and in every case a caller-side presence guard, an in-helper NULL fallback, or an iterator-provided argument covers the exact attribute: (1) drbd_nla.c:31/44 drbd_nla_parse_nested/drbd_nla_find_nested — guarded by the generated __<struct>_from_attrs 'if (!tla) return -ENOMSG' (include/linux/genl_magic_func.h:144-151), drbd_adm_prepare's 'if (info->attrs[DRBD_NLA_CFG_CONTEXT])' (drbd_nl.c:191-194), and find_cfg_context_attr's nla_find NULL check (drbd_nl.c:3289-3291), with capable(CAP_NET_ADMIN) (not ns_capable) at drbd_nl.c:169 blocking userns reachability; (2) ip_tunnel_core.c:583 ip_tun_parse_opts opens with 'if (!attr) return 0' (line 590); (3) seg6_local.c:1304 parse_nla_bpf and the other parse_nla_* callbacks run only after the required-attr loop 'if (!attrs[i]) return -EINVAL' (1682-1683) or the optional-attrs skip test; (4) nexthop.c:2650 rtm_nh_get_timer and nh_valid_dump_nhid have in-helper 'if (!attr)' fallbacks; (5) pmsr.c:174 pmsr_parse_peer/ftm receive only nla_for_each_nested iterator values with tb[] guards at 187-192/216; (6) openvswitch flow_netlink.c:2636 validate_and_copy_set_tun and the genev/vxlan/erspan/ip_tun_from_nlattr chain receive iterator-provided attrs, while validate_and_copy_sample (2434) NULL-checks probability/actions at 2457-2462, and datapath.c ovs_flow_cmd_new/ovs_packet_cmd_execute guard KEY/ACTIONS/PACKET (936-942, 563-565) and ovs_nla_get_match synthesizes a NULL mask (1792-1808); (7) nf_tables_api.c:2684 nf_tables_expr_parse/nft_expr_init — nft_expr_type_get returns ERR_PTR on NULL NAME (2612-2614), NFTA_EXPR_DATA is if/else memset-guarded (2702-2711), and all nft_set_elem_expr_alloc/setelem dispatch call sites are if-guarded or nla_for_each_nested-gated (4413, 4429, 5257-5263, 5754, 5778, 6019-6034, 6296-6300), with nft_set_desc_concat_parse checking tb[NFTA_SET_FIELD_LEN] (4151); (8) qeth_l2_main.c:796 gates bp_tb[IFLA_BRPORT_LEARNING_SYNC] at 834; (9) team.c:2555 guards NAME/TYPE at 2557-2560, attr_data at 2583-2586, PORT_IFINDEX/ARRAY_INDEX individually; (10) devlink.c:272 *_get_from_attrs helpers each check the exact slot before nla_get_* (252-253, 277-278, 304-305, 326-327, 169-171, 222-224), devlink_port_fn_state_set is called only under 'if (attr)' (1126-1128), and devlink_nl_cmd_port_new_doit requires FLAVOUR+PF_NUMBER (1284-1286). Bounded limitations: helpers outside the named priority files were enumerated in prior s02 artifacts but not re-traced; OVS validate_and_copy_clone/dec_ttl/check_pkt_len and conntrack.c/actions.c consumers were verified only for the shared iterator-provides-argument pattern; nf_tables expression .init callbacks beyond nft_bitwise belong to the i018 kind-callback branch; devlink direct nla_get(info->attrs[]) doit sites belong to the i007 direct-index branch whose session was truncated before devlink.c was deep-read; l2tp_netlink.c was pattern-scanned, not re-read function-by-function; no compilation or runtime reproducer was run (read-only snapshot, no top-level Makefile/Kconfig).
